description: Digital Road Atlas (DRA) - Demographic Partially-Attributed Roads is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoBC Branch. Digital Road Atlas Demographic Partially-Attributed Roads (DGTL ROAD ATLAS DPAR SP) provides partial information about roads in British Columbia. This data set represents the public data that is available for the Digital Road Atlas. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher GeoBC Branch. Its tags are provincial digital road atlas. It offers 3 resource(s) in MULTIPLE, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
